title: What Is a Turbomolecular Pump (TMP)? Why Roughing Is Needed and the Two-Stage Setup That Creates High Vacuum
excerpt: Why is a turbomolecular pump paired with a roughing pump? How high vacuum is created. The vacuum in semiconductor equipment is not created by a single pump. The TMP handles the high-vacuum side, while another pump handles roughing at startup and supports the backing pressure on the outlet side […]
